summary: A charity, foundation or community project that raises one-off and monthly donations: mission and current campaign, what each gift buys, programmes, stories, a donate page and a transparency report.

pages.purpose: State the mission, show the current campaign and its progress, prove impact, and turn interest into a gift or a volunteer sign-up.

sections.purpose: The mission in one line, a photo of the work, and the current campaign meter.
fields: Photo of the work in the field
Amount raised, goal, number of donors, end date
sections.notes: The campaign GoalMeter shows raised against the goal, backers and days left as text as well as a bar.

sections.purpose: A few hard figures with their source and year.
fields: Impact figures with label, year and source

sections.purpose: Pick an amount (one-off or monthly, presets or own) and see itemised what it buys.
alternatives: card: a hand-built gift slip beside button-group presets
pricing-table: a few fixed giving levels
cta: when donating happens on a provider's page only
fields: Preset amounts for one-off and monthly
Unit costs: what one item costs (a kit, a session, a month of support)
sections.notes: AmountPicker with one-off and monthly presets (a function swaps them per frequency), an own amount with a minimum and an impact line per amount. A slip next to it can list what the amount buys in plain text; the summary updates in an aria-live region. Any drawing that visualises the gift is decorative (aria-hidden). The chosen amount carries to the donate page.

sections.purpose: What the organisation actually does: each programme with one measurable fact.
alternatives: media-text: two or three programmes with photos
fields: What it does and for whom

sections.purpose: Short stories from beneficiaries and partners.
How a gift becomes the work on the ground, in steps.
Call for volunteers or partners.
fields: What volunteers do and the time asked

sections.purpose: Updates on the campaign and the year's report.
alternatives: email-capture: a compact signup inside another section
fields: What subscribers receive and how often

pages.purpose: Complete a gift in two steps: amount and frequency, then donor details, then what happens next.

sections.purpose: Why give now, with the campaign meter in compact form.
Step 1: the same gift builder as the home page.
Step 2: donor name, email for the receipt, optional dedication and consent, then hand-off to the payment provider.
alternatives: checkout-01: the payment is taken on the site
fields: Consent texts for receipts and updates
sections.notes: Validate on submit; show the pledge with a reference after submitting. Say what the email is used for next to the field.

sections.purpose: What happens after the gift: receipt, updates, how to cancel a monthly gift.
fields: How to change or cancel a monthly gift

sections.purpose: Tax, security, bank transfer, corporate giving.

pages.purpose: Show where the money went: the year in figures, the spending split, the ledger, downloadable files and the board.

sections.purpose: Report year, audit status and publication date.
Income, spending and reach for the year.
Of every 100 given, how much went to each kind of spending.
alternatives: progress: four or fewer shares as bars
fields: Spending shares by category (programmes, operations, fundraising…)
sections.notes: Print the shares as text too; do not rely on chart colours.

sections.purpose: Income and spending tables with totals.
sections.notes: Use captions and a footer row with the total; right-align amounts with tabular numerals.

sections.purpose: Audited accounts, annual report and registration documents to download.
fields: Files with title, year, format and size

sections.purpose: Who governs the organisation.
Return to giving.

content: Mission statement and registration details (legal name, registration number)
Current campaign: name, goal, raised so far, donor count, end date
Preset amounts and what one unit of the work costs
Programmes with one measurable fact each
Impact figures with year and source
Stories and photos with consent from the people shown
Annual figures: income and spending lines, spending split
Audited accounts and annual report files

styles.name: warm report
styles.why: Serif headings over a sober report body and mono figures: earnest and accountable, suits foundations and community charities.

styles.name: plain civic
styles.why: Lightweight and highly legible for small associations and volunteer groups.

pitfalls: Impact numbers without a year or source read as marketing; always date and source them.
The gift visualisation carries the meaning; keep the itemised amounts as text and mark drawings decorative.
Tax-deduction or receipt claims that do not match the organisation's legal status.
Photos of children or vulnerable people without consent, or with identifying details.
Monthly gifts without a clear way to change or cancel.
No transparency report or files, or figures that do not add up to the totals.
Marketing consent bundled into the donation; keep updates opt-in.
